description: Build a purchase file for 1 to 6 candidate products against the same requirements (fields: units, billing, plan_id, budget_month, needs_monthly_billing, max_commitment_months, needs_free_plan, avoid_cost_traps, features, addons, usage and service). Returns per candidate the check with evidence, the cheapest fitting plan's cost where computable, our hands-on test results, unknowns and the handoff link with affiliate disclosure; a fixed order that never uses commission; a summary_markdown ready to display (it starts with the share link and says whether any candidate has a confirmed fit); a share_url; and depends_on facts so the file can be re-checked later. A feature counts as documented only from the vendor's own pages, never as tested by us. When requirements.modules names a setup ([{id, role}], e.g. a help desk plus a phone line), read setup_check for the verdict on the whole setup (its known costs per currency, open items and the budget for the setup as a whole); each candidate's own budget line compares that product alone.

product_ids.description: 1 to 6 candidate product ids, each as returned in the id field of product search results.
product_ids.title: Product Ids
